settings.content: Our long-form reference for stones, from the Four Cs to gemstone durability

settings.heading: Where to Begin
settings.body:
This is the reference guide behind all the others. Where the ring guides tell you how to choose a ring, this one tells you how to choose the stone that goes in it.

It covers diamonds properly, the Four Cs without the jargon, shapes, natural against lab-grown and fancy colour, then moves through coloured gemstones one at a time, with honest advice on what each can take.

It is longer than the others and not meant to be read in one sitting. Use the index and take what you need.
